title: Drums of the Spring Thaw
summary: Expedition rangers between Ada'soom's Gate and the Frost Throne of Kamal sabotage the steam-ice bastions where Kamal winter-hosts muster for the Rite of the Spring March.

hook.rumour: Steam-vents beneath the Frost Throne of Kamal are roaring day and night as Kamal smiths temper siege-hooks for the spring thaw vanguard near Ada'soom's Gate.
hook.notice: ADA'SOOM'S GATE OUTPOST: Sappers and scouts wanted to silence the siege-foundries at the Kamal Ice Halls before the thaw-march begins.

npcs.name: Warden of Ada'soom's Gate
npcs.greet: Steam-vents beneath the Frost Throne of Kamal are roaring day and night as Kamal smiths temper siege-hooks for the spring thaw vanguard near Ada'soom's Gate.
talk: The trouble across Kamal began when sealed dispatches started bypassing Ada'soom's Gate.
If you mean to help the Frostbreaker Watch, start by checking the trail between Adasooms Gate and Frost Throne of Kamal.

npcs.name: Chronicler of Ada'soom's Gate
npcs.greet: Keep your voice low—everyone at Frost Throne of Kamal is watching who asks after the old seals.
talk: We traced the couriers from Frost Throne of Kamal toward Kamal Ice Halls before they vanished into the brush.
Bring any ciphered tallies back to Ada'soom's Gate so Marshal Vorik can see the proof.

npcs.name: Outrider of Kamal Ice Halls
npcs.greet: You made good time from Frost Throne of Kamal. The saboteurs have fortified the approaches near Kamal Ice Halls.
talk: Their ringleader is holding the inner chamber at Kamal Ice Halls with a picked guard.
Once Kamal Ice Halls is cleared, return to Ada'soom's Gate to seal the regional compact.

npcs.name: Speaker of Ada'soom's Gate
npcs.greet: Marshal Vorik awaits word on whether the crisis in Kamal has been contained.
talk: The elders of Ada'soom's Gate have prepared the concord table for your return.
All of Kamal owes you a debt for standing between Adasooms Gate and ruin.
